title: Solar power saves NegOcc gov’t P5.6M; gov urges locals to explore switch

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Harnessing the power of the sun, the Negros Occidental provincial government has slashed P5,611,442.22 from its electricity bills following the installation of rooftop solar panels on three of its key buildings. Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson announced the energy savings Tuesday, Nov. 10, on the sidelines of the Solar Technology Roadshow held at the Negros Occidental Provincial Capitol here.
